errors.evidence: The x-axis categories (Test1, Test2, Test3, Test4, Test5) are ordered sequentially or numerically, not alphabetically.

errors.text_span: 其 EDR% 值均接近或略高于 40%
errors.evidence: This statement over-generalizes the performance of DNN-HMM. In Test1 and Test2, the values are approximately 38%, which is not 'close to or slightly above 40%'.

errors.text_span: EDR% 值在 17% 至 22% 之间
errors.evidence: The stated range for LSTM-HMM is incorrect. The value for Test4 is approximately 16%, which falls outside the specified range of [17%, 22%].

errors.text_span: EDR% 值在 17% 至 22% 之间
errors.evidence: The stated range for End-to-End is incorrect. The value for Test2 is approximately 16%, which falls outside the specified range of [17%, 22%].

errors.text_span: End-to-End（黄色）的柱状图高度最低
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The End-to-End bar is not the lowest in Test3, Test4, and Test5; in these cases, the LSTM-HMM bar is lower.
